# J&R NW Construction

> Licensed, bonded & insured general contractor serving the Portland, Oregon metro area. Oregon CCB #232708.

J&R NW Construction is a general contractor based in Portland, OR, specializing in home remodeling, siding installation, water damage restoration, structural repair, waterproofing, and painting. Serves Portland, Beaverton, Hillsboro, Gresham, Tigard, Lake Oswego, West Linn, and Clackamas.

Contact: (503) 998-2340 · jandrnwconstruction@gmail.com
Service area: Portland metro, Oregon

## Services

- Home Remodeling
- Siding Installation
- Water Damage Restoration
- Structural Repair
- Waterproofing
- Painting
- Drywall
- General Construction / Repairs
